title: Two clues, two unknowns
subject: Mathematics
objective: Solve two simultaneous equations by subtracting matching parts, then check both prices.

faq.a: They are two clues about the same unknown prices. The answer must make both clues true at the same time.
Both clues contain the same two pens. Taking one whole clue away from the other removes the pens and leaves only notebooks.
x and y are just short labels for the prices we do not know yet: x for one notebook and y for one pen.
Put the notebook price and pen price into both original clues. They must make both totals come out right.

steps.heading: Two shopping clues
steps.sub: Find the price of one notebook and one pen
steps.text: Here is a problem that sounds complicated. It is really just two clues about two prices. We will take it one small step at a time.

steps.title: The two clues
steps.text: Three notebooks and two pens cost one thousand six hundred naira. One notebook and the same two pens cost eight hundred naira.
We do not know either price. Let x mean the price of one notebook. Let y mean the price of one pen. These are called unknowns because their prices are hidden.

steps.title: Write the clues with x and y
steps.text: The first clue becomes three x plus two y equals one thousand six hundred. The second becomes x plus two y equals eight hundred.
Look at the two pens. There are two pens in each clue. If we take the smaller whole clue away from the larger one, those same two pen prices disappear.

steps.title: Subtract the matching clues
steps.text: Three notebooks take away one notebook leaves two notebooks. Two pens take away two pens leaves none. One thousand six hundred take away eight hundred leaves eight hundred.
So two notebooks cost eight hundred naira. If two equal notebooks cost eight hundred, one notebook costs half of that.

steps.title: Find one notebook
steps.text: Eight hundred shared equally between two notebooks is four hundred naira for one. We have found x.
Now put the notebook price, four hundred naira, into the second clue. That leaves only the price of the two pens to work out.

steps.title: Find one pen
steps.text: Take four hundred away from eight hundred. The two pens together cost four hundred naira, so one pen costs two hundred.
Let us test our answer in the shopping clues. If either total is wrong, then we need to go back and find our mistake.

steps.title: Check both clues
steps.text: Three notebooks at four hundred each, plus two pens at two hundred each, makes one thousand six hundred. The second clue makes eight hundred. Both are right.
So the mystery is solved. One notebook costs four hundred naira. One pen costs two hundred naira. Two clues, two unknowns, and no scary shortcut.
Your turn. Use the same idea.

ask.hint: Share 800 equally between the two x values.

steps.text: Exactly. You can solve a pair of clues by cancelling the part that matches.
